//customDomain: Written to dist/CNAME. Set to null to publish at the default *.github.io URL instead. Only set this once the DNS records are actually in place — GitHub ignores a CNAME file it cannot verify.
//basePath: Sub-path the site is served from, no trailing slash. The default GitHub Pages URL serves a project site under /<repo>, so this must be '/aixbiohub' there. Ignored when customDomain is set, because a custom domain serves from the root. Set this wrong and every link and stylesheet 404s.
//litmapsUrl: External citation map — opens in a new tab from the nav and the landing page.
//suggestFormUrl: TODO: paste the shared Airtable form URL for the 'User submitted' table here. Until it is set, the 'Suggest research' panel is omitted from the landing page.
//prerenderResults: Render every research card into research/index.html at build time, so the page has real content for search engines and works without JavaScript. Costs roughly 90KB gzipped at 250 records and grows with the library. Set to false to let JavaScript render the list instead.
